posts.author: Grayham
posts.content_md:
> **jrburns47wrote:↑Tue Jul 23, 2019 10:03 am:** why does it have to do with holography? Maybe there’s a forum somewhere that has to do with your 3D printer and it’s software.

With a 3D printer you can make mounts for mirrors, lenses, beam splitters, plate holders etc that work really well. 

And you can 3d print models and make holograms of those too.

I printed a really nice dragons head that I have been trying to make a decent hologram of 

You can pretty much design anything you want to capture in a hologram and print it out.

Grayham
